summary: FULL DAILY REFRESH: August ISM Services is now official at 55.4, with Business Activity 61.7, New Orders 60.9, Prices 72.6, Employment 47.8, Backlog 55.6, New Export Orders 56.3 and Imports 56.3. The new macro hierarchy therefore shifts from simple duration stress toward stagflationary services reacceleration: demand is strong, prices are hotter and hiring remains weak. Refined-product inflation stays #1 after US diesel retail reached a record $5.820/gal and diesel cracks a record $108.02/bbl. New #2 theme is Services Reacceleration + Hot Prices / Weak Hiring. AI / Transmission / Generation Long-Lead Capex rises to #3 after an official ISM-selected respondent explicitly linked large transmission/generation investment to material purchasing and long-lead planning. Structurally Higher Neutral Rate / Capital Competition is #4: Waller's dovish tactical signal lowered hike odds and the 10Y toward ~4.77%, but high mortgages/real rates still punish duration. Gold/precious metals rise to #5 after gold +2.3%, silver +2.8% and broad metals confirmation. Selective AI software rises after Snowflake raised FY27 product revenue guidance to $6.07B and attributed roughly half of recent acceleration to AI. Food/grain rerouting phases in after Black Sea disruption pushed Asian buyers toward higher-priced Australian/Argentine wheat; farm-input elasticity rules remain unchanged. Dominion shareholder approval of the $66.8B NextEra merger creates a new research-only Utility Consolidation + Data-Centre Load Cost Allocation theme; NEE/D are not promoted until regulatory/customer-bill economics are clearer. All eight current holdings were reviewed individually: no fundamental-score changes. XOM ~$162.2 fell below $164-166 reclaim; MISC RM7.77 broke first support; HIBISCS RM2.23 held >RM2.20; YTLPOWR RM5.75 reclaimed RM5.65-5.70; TTWO ~$214.13 broke old $216-217 support but remains above ~$210 reassessment; TSLA ~$376 rallied after the Austin Cybercab launch but remains 61/C pending fleet economics/regulatory/safety proof; DAYANG RM1.45 reclaimed first level without operating proof; 6742UW remains parent/terms only. High-quality queue now starts ETN, FCX, BG, CCJ, PWR, CTVA, CRWD, LNG, VMI, CF/NTR with entry discipline. TradingView Top Stories capture remained partially dynamic/stale and was discovery-only; RockBtmEntries remains incomplete, and the 'largest QQQ transaction ever' claim remains unverified/zero-weight. Daily Investment Brief placeholders were not inferred; retired macro dashboard not used. Research/data only; no core UI/scoring/backend architecture changes.

FULL DAILY REFRESH: refined-product inflation/Hormuz moved to #1 after European gasoline cracks exceeded $62/bbl and diesel margins remained near $79/bbl over Brent, while EIA showed US crude -4.5M bbl, gasoline -1.2M bbl, 98% refinery utilisation and record-low East Coast distillates; falling total product supplied adds an early demand-destruction warning. Long-end yield/term-premium stress stays #2 as US10Y again touched ~4.81% despite ADP private payrolls slowing to +38k. NEW #3 PHASING-IN theme: AI Time-to-Power / Microgrids after Vertiv agreed to acquire UtilityInnovation Group for ~$1.45B cash plus up to $1.15B contingent consideration, adding microgrid controls, specialised switchgear and behind-the-meter power architecture; VRT research conviction raised 7.3→7.7, with valuation discipline unchanged. AI load-quality/ghost-demand stays #4 rather than disappearing: real microgrid demand and speculative interconnection queues can coexist, so funded-load evidence remains mandatory. Fertilizer/feedstock rises to #5 as CF hit records on nitrogen scarcity, but the stock is explicitly no-chase. Consumer stress/weak hiring moves #6. Americas crude/LNG, selective software/cyber, gold and uranium/fuel complete the top ten. Every current holding was reviewed individually from the canonical ledger: no fundamentals score changes; XOM $164.17 remains in reclaim test, MISC RM8.00 back at support, HIBISCS RM2.25 holds above confirmation, YTLPOWR RM5.62 tested RM5.47 intraday, TTWO ~$216.18 support softened, TSLA ~$357 becomes HOLD / no add before Sep 3 Cybercab, DAYANG RM1.43 remains do-not-average-down, 6742UW remains parent/terms only. High-quality queue now begins CCJ, ETN, VMI, CRWD, LNG, PWR, FCX; CF/CTVA/BG are wait-for-retest. August ISM Manufacturing reverified at 54.6; August Services is not yet published at this run and no value was inferred. Daily Investment Brief still returned placeholders; old macro dashboard was not used. TradingView Top Stories was reviewed only for discovery. RockBtmEntries remains incomplete/blocked and the 'largest QQQ transaction ever' claim remains unverified/zero-weight. No new ticker cleared the promotion bar beyond the VRT research upgrade; zinc enters research-only as a Western refined-metal scarcity subtheme.

SUPPLEMENTAL CONSUMER + SPECIAL-SITUATION UPDATE: reviewed the TradeWithCong VYX claim. Repeated Ro Khanna VYX purchases are real, but federal STOCK Act disclosures report transaction bands rather than exact shares/dollars, so the social claim of ~$105K invested at an exact $8.01 average is not treated as verified. VYX was nevertheless promoted on its own fundamentals: Q2 recurring revenue $435m, Commerce Platform remaining contract value $286m (+65% YoY), maintained 2026 adjusted FCF-unrestricted before restructuring guidance of $190-220m, and company repurchases around $6.70-$7.42 in Q2. VYX enters All Ideas and the selective Watchlist as a cash-flow-inflection/corporate-simplification special situation, with ~$1.1bn long-term debt and preferred capital keeping it below the top scarcity-quality names. Consumer Stress / Trade-Down enters the top-five Developing Themes after FirstCash U.S. same-store pawn receivables rose 19% YoY (+32% two-year stacked) for a twelfth consecutive double-digit quarter; the consolidated +63% headline is explicitly not used as the underlying U.S. consumer rate because acquisitions/international expansion distort it. FCFS enters All Ideas/Watchlist as a quality beneficiary and alternative-data indicator but is wait-for-retest after its rerating. Current Holdings macro reads were updated: TSLA gets an additional financing/affordability headwind; TTWO remains comparatively insulated; XOM/MISC/HIBISCS retain the best current-regime fit; YTLPOWR remains a funded-load/FCF quality test; DAYANG still needs work-order/utilisation conversion rather than merely high spot oil. No holding fundamental scores changed.

This raises the evidence bar for AI-power projects without downgrading real supplier backlog. August ISM Manufacturing is now official at 54.6: New Orders 53.7, Production 58.3, Prices 71.1, Supplier Deliveries 59.3, with electrical/electronic/memory/copper/wire scarcity still prominent. Oil/refined products and global long yields strengthened together: Brent $94.65, WTI $90.22, diesel at a 52-month high, US10Y near 4.80%, official real 10Y TIPS 2.44%, Japan10Y 3%. Grid/OT cybersecurity was added as a phasing-in theme. Gold/monetary hedges were tactically demoted after gold broke below its 200-day trend despite the structural thesis remaining intact. High-quality action queue now starts CCJ, ETN, VMI, CF, CTVA, PWR, CRWD, LNG, BG, FCX; CF/CTVA/BG are no-chase after Sep 1 strength while CCJ/ETN/VMI improved on entry. Every current holding was reviewed: no fundamental-score changes; HIBISCS cleared >RM2.20, XOM entered $164-166 reclaim, YTLPOWR slipped below first support, TTWO/TSLA are testing/approaching support. Daily Investment Brief placeholders were not inferred; old macro dashboard remained excluded. TradingView was used only as partially accessible discovery input; RockBtmEntries coverage remained blocked/incomplete and the 'largest QQQ transaction ever' claim remains unverified/zero-weight. Research/data only; no core UI/scoring/backend changes.

GOLD / CRYPTO / SPIN-OFF / CRITICAL-MINERAL EXTENSION: added first-class Gold / Monetary Hedges and Crypto / Digital-Asset Liquidity themes, plus Western Critical-Mineral Sovereignty and Corporate Breakups / Pure-Play Re-rating. FLEX emerged as the strongest additional pre-spin setup: Cloud & Power Infrastructure Q1 revenue +35% with 9.7% margin, 65–75% FY27 growth guidance and 80%+ FY28 outlook ahead of a targeted Q1 2027 spin. SOLS and LHX remain strong separation/value-unlock ideas; Q is a profitable semiconductor-materials spin; HONA stays wait-for-proof after a guidance reset. Watchlist reranked around CF, CTVA, GLDM, AEM, BG, CCJ, FLEX, KGC, LNG, WPM, PWR, SOLS, ETN and LHX. Gold is structurally strengthening but tactically fragile into the September Fed decision; BTC/COIN/MSTR are explicitly separated by liquidity/capital-structure risk. TTWO was rechecked after the GTA VI reveal: no fundamental downgrade; BofA's review argues the playable build lowers further-delay risk, so HOLD / small add only after stabilization remains the action.
